integrity: The result is derived directly from the open-access source density, CDF, survival function, quantile formula, and mean-residual-life theorem. The source was inspected in full at the relevant pages, including rendered equation pages. Numerical checks only replay exact formulas.
scientific_limitations: The correction is confined to the published quantile and mean-residual-life formulas.
The indeterminacy shift is treated as fixed, as in the source density and likelihood.
The empirical model comparison and parameter-estimation sections are not reassessed.
title: NMED is a shifted Gamma law, correcting its quantile and mean residual life
